survey_takeaways: The cleanest post-current weekly admission candidate is Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.
The official Qwen3.6 family surfaced in this survey starts at 27B and 35B-A3B; that is not a clean single-L4 successor to the closed 3B/4B dense weekly line.
Gemma 4 small models are plausible compatibility-lane work, but not current-mainline admissions, because the repo lacks AutoProcessor and multimodal-aware loading.
No surveyed candidate landed in a pure auth-only lane; the gated candidates here also expand protocol and loader assumptions.
